items.author: Eric Summers, rebuilds Tableau dashboards as Data Apps, 2x Tableau Ambassador, Nov 21
items.summary: "Over twenty data apps later": Data Apps let you ask for what you wanted instead of building dual-axis and polygon workarounds (PISA dots for 90 countries, a hot-air-balloon spotting game, a refresh health check that ranks stale data by how many people opened it). He's hosting a free 90-minute live "Discover Data Apps" session today at 11 AM ET and will build one live from a plain request. 5 reactions, 4 comments.

items.author: Camila L., Data Analyst, Operations & Business Analytics, Nov 21
items.summary: Built a Walmart Sales Explorer Data App from a published Tableau Cloud source using Tableau Agent prompts (finding: type B stores sell 38% more per sq ft). Useful caution: validating in Python, she caught the agent's formula error in sales per sq ft ($46.97 vs. the true $118.81). [Dashboard](https://lnkd.in/essJ-MXQ). Counts not shown yet.

items.author: Ajay Vishnu Addala, Tableau Ambassador, Senior Consultant @ Eigen X, Philadelphia TUG leader, Nov 20
items.summary: Rebuilt his 2024 Chess.com recap overnight as an interactive Data App (dark UI, KPI tiles, win/loss bars by opening and rating gap), hosted through Tableau Public via GitHub Pages, inspired by Jeb Besecker's Data Defense app. [App](https://lnkd.in/dfRUfDMq). 17 reactions, 2 comments, 1 repost.

items.author: Abdullah Hasan, Senior Data Analyst @ Procore, Nov 19
items.summary: Put a design system on top of his Tableau dashboards so they build faster with less formatting; "Pedal Power" shows three styles (Catalogue, Frame Drawing, Dispatch) across strategic, operational and analytical layers. Notes AI still needs human review for "thinking ahead." [Tableau Public](https://lnkd.in/ddx8_4rJ). 13 reactions, 1 comment.

items.author: Pankaj Namekar, BI Consultant, Power BI (PL-300), Microsoft Fabric, Nov 20
items.summary: "Helvetia Horizons," a 5-page Power BI report on Swiss tourism where every visual is custom HTML/SVG written in DAX (bubble map, market-to-destination flow, occupancy calendar with 6-month forecast, sentiment and sustainability scorecards), no custom-visual licences. 18 reactions.

items.summary: Design-driven viz inspired by a Karel Martens wallpaper pattern, with an interactive version at [the viz](https://lnkd.in/dUfs7mcD). 15 reactions, 6 comments, 1 repost.
